examples.input:
The following observations were collected during the task: Perform three sequential high-quality scans of the same 10x10 µm² area using identical scanning parameters (points per line: 128, lines per frame: 128). Set the time per line such that all three scans are completed within 2 min 34 s, and use a scanning mode that minimizes tip damage. For each scan, collect the topographic data and then calculate the root-mean-square roughness.
 Below are few scenarios that may contain correct agent actions

 Scenario A: Observation: {'tool_name': 'Code_Executor', 'arguments': {'code': '
import nanosurf
import time

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application

# All variables
scan = application.Scan

# Set scan parameters
scan.ImageWidth = 10e-6  # [m]
scan.ImageHeight = 10e-6  # [m]
scan.Points = 128  # points per line
scan.Lines = 128  # lines per frame

# Calculate time per line
total_time_seconds = 2 * 60 + 34  # 2 minutes and 34 seconds
time_per_line = total_time_seconds / (3 * scan.Lines)  # Divide by 3 scans

scan.Scantime = time_per_line  # [s] time per line

# Start scan
scan.StartFrameUp()  # Scanning from bottom to top

# Check if scanning
scanning = scan.IsScanning
while scanning:
    print("Scanning in progress... Remaining lines:", (scan.Lines - scan.Currentline))
    time.sleep(3)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning

print("Scanning finished")

# Clean up
del spm
